items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: Yeah, I know Freddie. Newrock, is it? Freddie Newrock. Yeah, he played in all these big brass bands.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know Freddie. Newrock, is it? Freddie Newrock. Yeah, he played in all these big brass bands. Seems like it. But all about music. He played by music. He couldn't fake a note.

Another name I have here is Pete Dietrich. Do you remember that? Pete Dietrich. Pete, it looks like Dietrich. No, I don't remember. Is that a white man? Yes, I think so. And Doc looks like Berriesen. B-E-H. Orange? Orange? No, B-E. B-E-H-R-E-A-S-O-N. Barenzy? Barenzy? Barenzy? Barenzy? Maybe that's it. Barenzy? No, I don't know. Doc? I don't know. Yeah. No, I don't know yet. Those are some of the names I was going to ask you about. And what about the Christian boys? Do you remember them? All of them. Yeah. All…
